_comment: Closed category taxonomy. Single source of truth for ingest.mjs, query.mjs and mcp-server.mjs. Adding a value here is the ONLY way to introduce a new category.

descriptions.ai-coding: writing or reviewing code with AI assistants
descriptions.ai-agents-and-automation: autonomous agents, workflows and automating tasks with AI
descriptions.ai-prompting: prompt technique, context engineering, getting better output
descriptions.ai-models-and-apis: the models themselves, benchmarks, APIs, running models locally
descriptions.ai-productivity: using AI for everyday work: notes, email, research, admin
descriptions.design-and-ui: visual design, interfaces, typography, design systems
descriptions.music-and-audio: music production, instruments, sound design, audio gear
descriptions.marketing-and-content: growing an audience, social strategy, copywriting, SEO
descriptions.business-and-career: running a business, pricing, hiring, career decisions
descriptions.personal-finance: money, investing, tax, pensions, crypto, currencies, economics
descriptions.health-and-psychology: physical health, nutrition, mental health, neuroscience, neurodiversity
descriptions.privacy-and-security: surveillance, encryption, digital rights, staying secure
descriptions.other: genuinely does not fit any category above
